summary: Pilot-only nested-CV KNN (k, weights, feature screen chosen in inner folds); write cv_auc alone
reasoning: Route knn: nested-CV k-nearest-neighbours on pilot alone. The pairs trail (step-14) established on pilot data that the signal lives strongly in pairwise products (logistic on pairwise products: cv_auc 0.8923), so I offer KNN two candidate feature sets inside the inner CV: the 12 raw features, and raw + all 66 pairwise products, each univariately screened (SelectKBest f_classif, screen size a hyperparameter). The pipeline (ExpandProducts -> StandardScaler -> SelectKBest -> KNeighborsClassifier) guarantees the screen is refit per fold, so nothing leaks; inner 4-fold GridSearchCV (n_jobs=1) picks expansion, screen size, k in [5,11,21,41,81] and weighting; outer 5-fold cross_val_score over the grid search yields the nested cv_auc. Pilot-only run writes only cv_auc to out/metrics.json. Expectation: a local, non-parametric method over interaction-rich features should reach the 0.80 pilot floor; if it falls short I will revisit the grid on pilot only.
